title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
"My sugars have been high for a few days."

HPI
The patient is a known patient with type 1 diabetes mellitus. He reports feeling unwell due to persistent hyperglycemia over the last few days. He stated that managing his type 1 diabetes with his insulin regimen has been difficult recently, leading to elevated glucose readings. He denies any other acute complaints.

Medication List
Insulin (long-term use)

Exam
Vitals are stable. Physical exam is largely unremarkable, noting skin turgor is adequate.

Assessment
The patient presents with hyperglycemia. His type 1 diabetes mellitus remains a focus of care, and his current management requires adjustment of his insulin dosage.

Plan
Continue long-term use of insulin. The patient needs to adjust his insulin dosing schedule to manage the current hyperglycemia. Follow up in one week to reassess glucose control.
explanations: Type 1 diabetes with hyperglycemia / poor control: E10.65.
Do not assign Z79.4 for type 1 diabetes; insulin use is inherent.

distractors.why: Z79.4 is not assigned for type 1 diabetes.
